typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFileNamePrefix as string (),
	ArchiveFolderPath as string (),
	ArchivePathFileName as string (),
	Delimiter as string (),
	EnvironName as string (),
	FilePattern as string (),
	FolderPath as string (),
	JobCode as string (),
	JobFileId as integer (),
	JobId as integer (),
	LogFileName as string (),
	OverrideProcessMonth as string (),
	PathFileName as string (),
	ProcessJob as string (),
	TidalJobNumber as string (),
	XlsSheetName as string (),
	XmlRowTag as string (),
	XmlXsltFile as string ()
}

source(output(
		InputLine as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(InputLine = InputLine) ~> PlaceHolderScriptGetLineNumber
PlaceHolderScriptGetLineNumber derive(JobId = $JobId,
		JobFileId = $JobFileId) ~> DerivedColumnAddColumns
DerivedColumnAddColumns sink(input(
		InputLine as string,
		LineNumber as integer,
		JobId as integer,
		JobFileId as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		InputLine,
		LineNumber,
		JobId,
		JobFileId)) ~> OLEDBDestination
